name: Level_1 - Task_5
description: Construct a Platinum (Pt) (111) surface slab with a 2 × 2 surface cell, 4 atomic layers, and a 10 Å vacuum layer. Constrain the bottom 2 atomic layers of the slab so they are fixed during optimization. Add a Carbon Monoxide (CO) molecule oriented with the Carbon atom directly above a surface Pt atom (at the atop site), with its initial z-coordinate 1.8 Å above the z-coordinate of the top-layer Pt atoms. Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator. Perform geometry optimization using a quasi-Newton optimizer (e.g., BFGS) until the maximum force is below 0.05 eV/Å for three configurations: the combined slab-CO system (with bottom slab layers constrained), the clean reference slab (with bottom slab layers constrained), and an isolated reference CO molecule centered in a simulation box providing 5 Å of vacuum padding on all sides.
